families.description: A finite-horizon noisy line-grid perturbation drops hit probability; a stale abstraction reports the old probability, while a reflected abstraction reports the drop.
A single hit-probability scalar can match while the finite-horizon profile differs, so stochastic continuation audits should retain profiles rather than only one scalar.
